recipe.visualDefinition: A central full-body portrait of a man in urban denim attire against a chain-link fence, framed by vibrant, multi-colored psychedelic borders with a heavy cyan-blue color grade and high-contrast lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Cyan-tinted central photography vs. hyper-saturated rainbow borders
Vertical stacked typography vs. diagonal corner callout
Hard industrial textures (fence, concrete) vs. soft organic watercolor border patterns
coreInvariants: Heavy cyan/blue monochromatic tint on the central figure
Vertical border strips featuring a 'lava lamp' or 'oil-on-water' texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body male figure centered, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's torso and open denim shirt, creating a high-contrast focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-center title, moves down the subject's body, then to the vertical text on the left, ending at the diagonal corner badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized in the upper right (fence) and lower left (concrete) to balance text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan and deep blue (monochromatic photo tinting)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multi-color spectrum (magenta, yellow, green, purple) in the borders
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the borders contrasting with a desaturated, single-hue photographic core.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid natural skin tones; maintain the blue wash
Borders must contain full CMYK spectrum

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and ultra-wide geometric block
letterConstructionRules: Vertical text uses high x-height and narrow width
Top title uses extreme horizontal expansion with internal texture
Corner text uses a simple, small-scale sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title letters filled with a purple/blue cloud texture
Vertical text features slight drop shadows for legibility against the background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-wide title vs. ultra-narrow body text.

preserve: Vertical stacking of the left-side text
Cyan color wash on the photo

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and narrow profile of the vertical text.
Provides the wide, geometric feel for the top title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body photo of a man in 90s urban fashion (baggy jeans, open denim shirt, sunglasses) standing against a chain-link fence. Apply a heavy cyan/blue monochromatic filter. Add vertical borders on the left and right sides featuring a colorful, psychedelic, oil-spill watercolor texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a wide, textured geometric title at the top center. Stack condensed black sans-serif text vertically on the left side. Add a diagonal dark blue ribbon in the bottom right corner with small red warning text.

verificationChecks: Is the photo heavily tinted blue?
Are the side borders multi-colored and psychedelic?
Is the top title horizontally stretched?
Is there a diagonal ribbon in the bottom right corner?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
Degree of horizontal stretch on the title font

mustAchieve: High contrast between blue photo and rainbow borders

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue tint doesn't obscure facial features entirely.
Check that the vertical text is legible against the background.
Verify the border texture looks like liquid or watercolor, not digital noise.
Confirm the diagonal ribbon is angled at exactly 45 degrees.
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply a [Color] monochromatic wash to a [Subject] photo, frame with [Texture] vertical borders, and overlay with [Width Contrast] typography.
